scientific_integrity: The discrete BMOd seminorm uses arithmetic interval mean absolute deviation on all finite consecutive blocks. An exact rational short-block certificate and an analytic infinite-tail argument establish the unique one-jump minimizer.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines the one-jump infimum alpha_d, not the sharp reverse inequality on all decreasing sequences; its originality has the documented source-access limits.
title: Exact one-jump constant in the discrete reverse Hardy–BMO problem
